thread:
ryan: Hey team, quick one from my Tokyo trip. Took a taxi from Haneda to Shibuya, driver gave a handwritten receipt for JPY 4,200 but the corp card charge posted as JPY 4,800 (preauth + tolls?). Ramp shows USD 36.42 on the statement. Which amount do I put on the expense?

zara: If the merchant folio/receipt is JPY 4,200 we normally code to the receipt amount and attach the bank stmt as an FX variance. Did you get a paper voucher from the taxi?

ryan: just the handwritten receipt. driver said there was an airport surcharge and card terminal added it after the ride. I paid nothing in cash.

expense-bot: Upload the handwritten receipt and the card statement to the expense item titled "HND->Shibuya - 2026-07-02". If charge != receipt, finance will mark as "FX/settlement variance" and advise next steps.

zara: thanks. Ben in card-ops may need to dispute with the processor if terminal-added charges look fraudulent. @ben can you advise?

ben: can do. two things: 1) we need the merchant descriptor and transaction id from the Ramp activity (last4 2109) 2) if the terminal added legitimate airport surcharge we can't dispute, we can reimburse the receipt amount and book the delta to FX variance or travel rounding policy. Can you paste the Ramp txn id?

ryan: Ramp txn shows `RMP-TXN-556677`. Merchant descriptor: "TOKYO TAXI CO". Uploaded both docs now.

ben: opened ticket FIN-2026-TA-1103 with Ramp ops to review settlement breakdown. Estimated 5-12 business days. If ramp confirms post-auth terminal surcharge by merchant, we'll reimburse JPY 4,200 and treat JPY 600 as merchant surcharge recovery ticket.

travel-ops: small policy note for travelers: keep any terminal vouchers and ask drivers to itemize airport surcharges on receipts. Ill add a line to the travel tips doc so folks know to request full itemization.

expense-bot: Expense status: "Docs attached  dispute review opened". Expect update in 5-12 business days.

ryan: nice, thanks all. prefer dispute first so my per-diem math stays clean.

zara: noted. will follow up if we need manager sign-off to temporarily reimburse.

ben: will update thread once Ramp replies. :thumbsup:
